correctness.rationale: The finite variance yields v by expanding the logarithm of the one-letter avoidance probability through order n⁻²; the strictly monotone derivative bracket gives its sole maximum on [0,1]. The joint law centers by exact expectations. Conditional on latent retention decisions there are three independent occupancy streams. Fourier conditioning at their fixed totals gives the Schur complement, and the binomial fluctuation adds only ρ(1−ρ)Q² to the common-leaf variance. See the two limit proofs in RESULT.md. The finite code enumeration verifies neither limiting theorem.
